name: m3t4
description: Duel-with-wounds: two body-carrying knights fight a seeded mirror duel beside an idle attackable villager unit (all spawned with Body rows via the spawner body options). Strikes allocate hediff severity across the six parts (torso/head 50%, arms 30%, legs 20% via the pure seeded roll); the duel loser dies BY TRAUMA — cumulative active severity crosses the whole-body threshold while hp remains — through the same UNIT_DEATH pipeline as hp kills. The surviving knight (leg-impaired from the duel) then marches onto the villager and cuts it down by plain HP exhaustion — both death modes coexist in one run. The long tail runs the rare-tick machine: light wounds drain clean inside their recovery windows while severe ones heal-at-full-severity into permanent scars. Fixture pins milestone digests every 60th tick, a wound/scar arc sampled at fixed ticks, the death-ledger rows, and doubles as the extended double-run determinism canary.
